scientific_integrity: All results are mathematical arguments internal to this manuscript; finite checks are illustrative and not independent mathematical certification. Prior deterministic 2LI criterion credited explicitly.
scientific_limitations: Fixed q and dense i.i.d. uniform finite-field matrices; no sparse, real, isomorphism-class sampling or exact nonrigidity constant. Exact basis-uniqueness occupancy law only asserted for q>3; property 2LI probability exact for all q. Conditional result covers matrices singular in the full vector-space sense. An equivalent unindexed result remains possible.
title: Random singular evolution algebras are asymptotically rigid over every finite field
